name: JARVIS_ROUTER v2
description: JARVIS Router v2: clasifica intenciones por regex (recordatorio, consulta, calendario_crear, calendario_consulta, foto, default) y enruta a los workflows correspondientes. Incluye soporte completo para Google Calendar.

parameters.query: =SELECT COALESCE((SELECT id FROM jarvis_users WHERE telegram_user_id = {{ $('Normalizar Input Router').first().json.userId }}), 0) AS db_user_id

=INSERT INTO jarvis_reminders (user_id, title, remind_at, status) VALUES ({{ $json.dbUserId }}, '{{ $json.reminderTitle.replace(/'/g, "''").substring(0, 200) }}', '{{ $json.reminderDatetime }}'::timestamptz, 'pending') RETURNING id

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chatId: $('Clasificar Intencion').item.json.chatId, message: $('Clasificar Intencion').item.json.responseMessage, parseMode: 'Markdown' }) }}

parameters.query: =WITH r AS (SELECT title, remind_at FROM jarvis_reminders WHERE user_id = {{ $json.dbUserId }} AND status = 'pending' AND remind_at > NOW() ORDER BY remind_at ASC LIMIT 10) SELECT * FROM r UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS title, NULL AS remind_at WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chatId: $json.chatId, dbUserId: $json.dbUserId, action: 'create', title: $json.calTitle, startDatetime: $json.calStartDatetime, endDatetime: $json.calEndDatetime }) }}
